resolvedWithinCapturedPath.observation: All 12 workspace images retain three legible toolbar symbols. All 36 native central-pixel measurements exceed 3:1; the minimum is 4.136177866044884:1.

Equilibrado and Restaurar are visibly present in the SDK26 customization frame. The five observed native popup controls and their recorded ancestors use the light style. Offscreen popup rendering was not visually assessed.

limitations: The inspected views are static 1050x772 viewports. Scrollable content below the viewport, other customization tabs and menus not opened in these images are outside the visual review.
Static screenshots do not demonstrate clicks, keyboard navigation, VoiceOver output, animation quality, absence of transient flicker, recovery after crashes, or PDF processing.

The native contrast check covers the central symbols of three toolbar controls with its declared 60-percent sample and p95/p05 luminance ratio. It is not a universal WCAG or all-colors accessibility certification.
